notes.content:
Today marks the 658th day of the Russia-Ukraine conflict and the 68th day of the Israel-Hamas conflict.

We have received an invitation to participate in the 2023 GAME STAR competition. This presents us with an opportunity to release this news. Since transitioning to a free-to-play model, we have lost the chance to gain exposure through special pricing. Therefore, we cherish every opportunity to issue news releases, and we are grateful for the 2023 GAME STAR.

[url=https://events.qoo-app.com/tca-gamestar2023/]https://events.qoo-app.com/tca-gamestar2023/[/url]

We plan to resume our original cover once one of these conflicts concludes, hoping that they won't end too far apart in time.

Praying for peace.

LILIEN GAMES
2023.12.13

آج روس-یوکرین تنازعہ کا 658 واں دن اور اسرائیل-حماس تنازعہ کا 68 واں دن ہے۔

ہمیں 2023 GAME STAR مقابلے میں شرکت کی دعوت موصول ہوئی ہے۔ اس سے ہمیں اس خبر کو جاری کرنے کا موقع ملتا ہے۔ فری-ٹو-پلے ماڈل کی طرف منتقلی کے بعد، ہم نے خصوصی قیمتوں کے ذریعے توجہ حاصل کرنے کا موقع کھو دیا ہے۔ اس لئے ہم ہر موقع کی قدر کرتے ہیں جہاں ہم پریس ریلیز جاری کر سکتے ہیں، اور ہم 2023 GAME STAR کے لئے شکرگزار ہیں۔

https://events.qoo-app.com/tca-gamestar2023/

notes.title: Mourning
notes.content:
On October 7th, Hamas launched an attack on Israel. In response, Israel retaliated and blocked the Gaza Strip.

We have changed the cover of our game to a black image in mourning for the deceased civilians.

We are a small team. I am currently developing two games and preparing for a gaming convention. I have a lot of work to do and need sufficient information to understand what happened, ensuring that my statements do not favor any particular side. Hence, I have a "time management plan" that helps me decide the priorities. So, it wasn't until today that I changed our cover.

In the war-torn areas, they are already gone.

My "time management plan" is a luxury for them.

Revenge is always right. The deceased will never return.

If you know of donation channels that can help the war-affected civilians, please share in the comments.

Praying for peace.

LILIEN GAMES
2023.10.31

7 اکتوبر کو، حماس نے اسرائیل پر حملہ کیا۔
اسرائیل نے جوابی کارروائی کی اور غزہ راہداری کو بند کر دیا۔

ہم نے اپنے کھیل کا اغلاف کالا تصویر سے بدل دیا ہے، تاکہ ہم مرنے والے شہریوں کو یاد کر سکیں۔

ہم بہت چھوٹی ٹیم ہیں۔
میں فی الحال دو کھیل تیار کر رہا ہوں، اور ساتھ ہی ساتھ ویڈیو گیم کی تشہیر میں شرکت کے لئے تیاری کر رہا ہوں۔
میرے پاس بہت سا کام کرنے کے لئے ہے، اور مجھے جاننے کے لئے کافی معلومات کی ضرورت ہے کہ کیا ہوا، تاکہ میں یقینی بنا سکوں کہ میری تقریر میں کسی بھی موقف کو ترجیح نہیں دی گئی ہے۔
اس لئے، میرے پاس ایک "وقت کا انتظام منصوبہ" ہے، جو مجھے فیصلہ کرنے میں مدد فراہم کرتا ہے کہ کون سی چیز کو ترجیح دی جائے۔
اسی وجہ سے آج تک میں نے ہمارے کھیل کا اغلاف تبدیل کیا۔

جبکہ جنگ کے علاقے میں، وہ پہلے ہی مر چکے ہیں۔

میرے "وقت کا انتظام منصوبہ" ان کے لئے ایک عیش کی شے ہے۔

انتقام ہمیشہ درست ہے۔
وہ لوگ جو مر گئے ہیں وہ کبھی واپس نہیں آئیں گے۔

اگر آپ جانتے ہیں کہ جنگ کے متاثرہ افراد کی مدد کے لئے کسی چینل کو چندہ دیا جا سکتا ہے، تو براہ کرم تبصرہ میں شیئر کریں۔

امن کی دعا ہے۔

ב-7 באוקטובר, חמאס הפעיל התקפה על ישראל.
ישראל הגיבה וסגרה את המעבר של עזה.

שינינו את הכיסוי של המשחק שלנו לצבע שחור כדי לזכור את האזרחים שנהרגו.

אנחנו קבוצה קטנה.
כרגע אני מכין שני משחקים וכמו כן מתכונן להשתתף בתערוכת משחקי הווידאו.
יש לי הרבה עבודה לעשות, ואני צריך לדעת מה קרה כדי לוודא שאין לי נטייה בהרצאה שלי.
לכן, יש לי "תוכנית ניהול זמן" שעוזרת לי להחליט איזו משימה לקחת קודם.
זה הסיבה ששיניתי את הכיסוי של המשחק שלנו היום.

באזור הקרב, הם כבר מתים.

ה"תוכנית ניהול הזמן" שלי היא פריט יוקרה בשבילם.

הנקמה אף פעם איננה הפתרון הנכון.
אלה שמתו לא ישובו אף פעם.

אם אתה יודע על ערוץ שניתן לתרום לו לטובת הנפגעים מהלחימה, אנא שתף בתגובה.

מתפללים לשלום.

notes.title: Changed to Free.
notes.content:
This is our promise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43372695/e8044a642cce2a2851f69f688c69aff62429ce9d.jpg[/img]

After careful consideration, we have decided to change the game to a free-to-play model, for the following reasons:

1.The price of the game could affect exposure, and profit is not our main goal.

2.The platform's commission may discount donations, and donating directly to a charity may be a better option.

We will be changing the game to a free-to-play model on April 11th, 2023. Of course, all sales revenue prior to that will still apply to our promise of donating 80%.

In the future, we may release DLCs or put the game on charity gaming platforms to achieve our charitable goals. This game will always be a charitable project.

If you support our cause, we invite you to donate. If you are unsure of where to donate, we recommend:

Ukrainian Red Cross
https://redcross.org.ua/en/donate/

You are also welcome to share this game in any way possible.

We pray for peace.

LILIEN GAMES
2023.4.4

notes.title: About Donations
notes.content:
80% of the game's revenue will be donated.

Our donation criteria have two conditions:

1.The country is currently in a state of war.
2.The unit is dedicated to assisting refugees from the above country.

Our current donation target is the Ukrainian Red Cross.
https://redcross.org.ua/en/donate/

Donations will be our permanent commitment.
Unless the first condition no longer applies.

We sincerely hope so.

Some details about donations:

1.We will settle accounts every time we receive STEAM's sales revenue.
2.When the accumulated amount (80% of game revenue) exceeds 120 USD, we will donate it all. If not, it will be accumulated until the next time.
3.If we want to change the donation target, it will happen after the donation, and the relevant announcement will be modified. You can decide whether to support us according to the announced target, or we encourage you to donate directly to the relevant unit.

notes.title: A Christmas Truce adaptation, "December 1914," is set to be released.
notes.content:
Lilien Games, a Taiwan-based indie game studio, has released the trailer for its new game December 1914. December 1914 supports multiple languages and is scheduled to be released on Steam on February 24, 2023 11:00 AM CST.

[previewyoutube=oFZIR-PV2vE;full][/previewyoutube]
December 1914 is a comic-style, narrative-driven game based on the Christmas Eve Truce of World War I. The player takes on the role of a soldier who has left his family to fight on the front lines and experience the events of December 1914. The game features four missions, each of which immerses the player in the traumatic experiences faced by soldiers, such as killing enemy soldiers, delivering supplies, defending positions, and executing prisoners of war.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43372695/cd81948a282718e2a2bd6c31f0688e168a10fadd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43372695/78af2306b24c206c398a9add8b2ed9f96a806398.png[/img]

The game has a unique feature called sanity value, which changes based on the player's actions. When the sanity value becomes too low, the player's perception of the world changes - colors fade and things become distorted. However, receiving a few supplies at night and thoughts of loved ones can help restore the player's sanity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43372695/b94b5126052ccae709ecbef96a12554087c9b426.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43372695/ed38b601f76ff34056b1cbd8ce8cde7f7b6bae50.png[/img]

On December 7, 1914, the Pope proposed a ceasefire for Christmas, but the proposal was rejected by the officials of the warring countries. However, on Christmas Eve, a miracle occurred, starting with a few brave soldiers...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43372695/51cbc70d1822728841f4eca8430600e2a300ff79.png[/img]

December 1914 features a single ending and is available in Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, French, German, Japanese, Ukrainian, and Russian. The December 1914 Steam page is now live, and the game is set to be released on February 24, 2023 11:00 AM CST.
